description: This source file defines API services related to scoring creatives, including functions for calculating component scores, composite scores, generating recommendations, and rendering scorecards in PDF and CSV formats. It interacts with models such as ScoreWeighting, Creative, and Audience, and uses external libraries like reportlab for PDF generation.

classes.name: ScoreComponents
classes.description: Dataclass representing individual component scores: brand lift, performance, and attention.

methods.name: Dict[str,float] get_active_weights()
methods.description: Returns the active weighting configuration, or default weights if none are active.

methods.name: float _normalize_score(v: float)
methods.description: Clamps a score value between 0.0 and 100.0.

methods.name: ScoreComponents compute_component_scores(creative: Creative, audience: Audience)
methods.description: Calculates individual component scores for a given creative and audience based on deterministic heuristics.

methods.name: Tuple[float,Dict[str,float]] compute_composite_score(components: ScoreComponents, weights: Dict[str, float])
methods.description: Computes a weighted average of component scores into a composite score and per-component contributions.

methods.name: List[Dict] generate_recommendations(components: ScoreComponents)
methods.description: Provides top diagnostics/recommendations based on weakest components of the score.

methods.name: bytes render_scorecard_pdf(data: Dict)
methods.description: Generates a PDF scorecard as bytes, summarizing the creative's scores and recommendations.

methods.name: str render_scorecard_csv(rows: List[Dict])
methods.description: Converts a list of score data dictionaries into a CSV string.

ctags.name: compute_composite_score
ctags.pattern: /^def compute_composite_score(components: ScoreComponents, weights: Dict[str, float]) -> Tuple[flo/
